hash_contract.canonicalization: Parse UTF-8 JSON, recursively sort object keys lexicographically, preserve array order, omit the top-level plan_sha256 field, serialize with ensure_ascii=true and separators=(',', ':'), append exactly one LF, then hash the UTF-8 bytes.
hash_contract.line_endings: Canonical bytes use LF regardless of checkout line endings; no BOM; recorded plan_sha256 is the digest of those unsigned canonical bytes.

facts: Current M14 and evidence-ledger status is D0 for TCAV, tuned lens, and disentanglement; D1 for activation patching and steering; no L04 D2/D3 artifact exists.

The real model boundary is TransformerLMIntegration, not ModelAdapter. ModelAdapter is N/A by deliberate architecture/ADR because GPT-2 exposes tokenized forward states and an LM head rather than encode/decode latent-space semantics.

Current activation_patch.py is a VAE encode/latent-delta/decode method and current steering.py is a NumPy latent-state method; neither is evidence of transformer clean/corrupted interchange patching or causal steering.
Current integrated_gradients.py and tcav.py have focused offline tests but no validator-backed real-model artifact, predeclared control envelope, or CUDA evidence.
inferences_and_limits: The authored fixture is suitable for a controlled D2/D3 protocol demonstration only; it does not establish external semantic validity or a general language-model explanation claim by itself.
A failed or underpowered real run remains a retained failure and cannot be promoted by changing thresholds, labels, or evidence level.
Direct logit lens is not tuned lens. A tuned-lens claim requires a separately fit affine translator and holdout calibration record; absent that record the tuned-lens row remains D0.

digest_contract.content: SHA-256 of the exact raw fixture file bytes, including JSONL line order and one LF per row, encoded as UTF-8 with no BOM; no parsing or normalization is applied.
digest_contract.split: Build payload {schema:'l04-fixture-split-v1', rows:[{row_id,group_id,split}]} using exactly those fields in that order; sort rows by (group_id,row_id); serialize compact JSON with ensure_ascii=true, separators=(',',':'), preserve array order, append exactly one LF, encode UTF-8 with no BOM, then SHA-256.
digest_contract.pair: Build payload {schema:'l04-fixture-pair-v1', pairs:[{causal_pair_id,group_id,clean_row_id,corrupted_row_id,split}]} using exactly those fields in that order; emit one object per pair from its clean row, sort pairs by (causal_pair_id), serialize compact JSON with ensure_ascii=true, separators=(',',':'), preserve array order, append exactly one LF, encode UTF-8 with no BOM, then SHA-256.
digest_contract.independent_recompute: A validator must recompute all three digests and fail closed on any mismatch; split and pair payloads must not include prompt text, labels, or fields outside the listed canonical payloads.

split.rule: Group is the split unit; both conditions of every causal pair stay in one split; no prompt, row, pair, or group crosses train/holdout.

causal_pair_mapping.pair_rule: Each causal_pair_id has exactly one clean and one corrupted row, identical task, shared group_id, and one split.

tokenization_and_sampling.tokenizer: GPT2TokenizerFast from the pinned model revision
tokenization_and_sampling.target_position: last non-padding prompt token; target_text is scored as the next-token class
tokenization_and_sampling.target_token_requirement: Resolve target_text to exactly one GPT-2 token and record token id/string; abort as failed if this invariant is false. The expected one-token property of ` true` and ` false` is only an offline contract check, not a pre-run fact or evidence claim.

target_token_offline_contract.check: Pinned GPT2TokenizerFast must tokenize each target_text to exactly one token with no added special token; fail closed otherwise.

tokenization_and_sampling.layer_indexing_rule: Transformer block h.L intervention maps to native output_hidden_states index L+1; record both indices.
tokenization_and_sampling.direction_fit: Train groups only; normalize direction on the train partition; no holdout fitting or threshold tuning.
tokenization_and_sampling.determinism: Set Python, NumPy, and Torch seeds; record deterministic-algorithm setting, CUDA device, and tool versions.

semantic_contracts.true_interchange_patch: Capture clean and corrupted hidden activations at the frozen layer/token, replace the corrupted activation with the clean activation during a corrupted forward pass, and measure recovery against clean/corrupted endpoints.
semantic_contracts.additive_intervention: Compute hidden := hidden + strength * direction as a separate diagnostic. It is not an interchange patch and cannot satisfy the activation-patching record by renaming.
semantic_contracts.direct_lens: Apply the model LM head under the integration's documented normalization semantics and report layerwise token probabilities.
semantic_contracts.tuned_lens: Fit an affine translator per layer on train groups only, freeze it, calibrate/report on holdout groups only, and compare against direct lens. A direct lens result must never be labeled tuned.
semantic_contracts.model_adapter: N/A for this lane; all records name TransformerLMIntegration as the concrete integration.

metric_formulas.aggregation: Compute per causal pair or per group first; aggregate the independent group/pair estimates across groups. Never treat the two rows in a pair as independent observations.
metric_formulas.task_margin: For each prompt, task_margin = logit(target_token) - logit(the_other_class_token), measured in logits; this is the scalar target for IG, TCAV, patching, and steering.
metric_formulas.ig_completeness: relative_error = abs(sum(attribution) - (task_margin(x) - task_margin(baseline))) / max(abs(task_margin(x) - task_margin(baseline)), 1e-12), dimensionless.
metric_formulas.ig_stability: cosine_16_64 = dot(a16,a64)/(||a16||_2*||a64||_2), dimensionless; aggregate median over groups.
metric_formulas.tcav_sensitivity: score = mean_group(1[directional_derivative(target_logit, concept_direction) > 0]), dimensionless; report group bootstrap 95% CI and compare against shuffled/random directions.
metric_formulas.disentanglement: heldout_gain = metric(real factor labels) - metric(group-preserving shuffled labels), dimensionless; report group-level bootstrap CI.
metric_formulas.patch_recovery: recovery = (task_margin(patched_corrupted)-task_margin(corrupted))/max(abs(task_margin(clean)-task_margin(corrupted)), 1e-12), dimensionless; off-target effect is absolute paired change in task_margin.
metric_formulas.steering_effect: target_effect = paired_mean(target_logit_margin(steered)-target_logit_margin(baseline)), measured in logits; selectivity = target_effect - mean(off_target_effects), also logits.
metric_formulas.lens: token_nll = -log(p[target_token]); calibration_kl = mean_token KL(p_true || p_translated) in nats; improvement = direct_value - tuned_value, with train fit and holdout calibration reported separately.
metric_formulas.confidence: All confidence intervals are two-sided percentile bootstrap 95% intervals over independent groups/pairs, with seed-specific estimates retained.

thresholds_and_controls.policy: Thresholds are frozen before real execution. Unless a field says max/atol, every *_min or *_strict_gt threshold uses strict > comparison; max/atol fields use <=. Report point estimate, units, aggregation unit, 95% CI, null distribution, comparator, and pass/fail for every control. Any unjustifiable zero-effect gate is blocked rather than accepted.

remote_cuda_workflow.transport_rule: Direct authenticated ssh.exe from Windows PowerShell only; no Git Bash, WSL, or edits to a persistent server checkout.
remote_cuda_workflow.precondition: Run only after the owner-approved implementation commit is pushed and reachable from origin; L04.1 itself does not commit or push.
powershell_commands: $UseCase = 'integrated_gradients' # choose exactly one value matching L04.4, L04.5, L04.6, L04.7, L04.8, L04.9, or L04.10; owner reviews before the next run

$RemoteScript = @'
set -eu
UseCase="$1"
CodeSha="$2"
RepoUrl="$3"
case "$UseCase" in integrated_gradients|tcav|direct_logit_lens|tuned_logit_lens|disentanglement|true_activation_patching|additive_steering) ;; *) exit 64;; esac
workdir="$(mktemp -d /tmp/latent-anything-l04.XXXXXX)"
case "$workdir" in /tmp/latent-anything-l04.*) ;; *) exit 90;; esac
test -d "$workdir"
trap 'rm -rf -- "$workdir"' EXIT HUP INT TERM
git clone --no-checkout "$RepoUrl" "$workdir/repo"
cd "$workdir/repo"
git checkout --detach "$CodeSha"
test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "$CodeSha"
export HF_HOME="$workdir/hf"
export UV_CACHE_DIR="$workdir/uv"
nvidia-smi
uv sync --locked --extra transformers
export LATENT_ANYTHING_RUN_NETWORK=1
export LATENT_ANYTHING_NETWORK_DEVICE=cuda
status=0
if uv run --extra transformers python -m scripts.m14_l04_explanations --run-real --use-case "$UseCase" --plan artifacts/m14/l04-explanations.plan.json --fixture artifacts/m14/l04-prompt-factor-fixture.jsonl; then :; else status=$?; fi
find artifacts/m14 -maxdepth 1 -type f -name 'l04-explanations*' -print > "$workdir/files.txt"
test -s "$workdir/files.txt"
tar -czf "$workdir/l04-capture.tgz" --files-from "$workdir/files.txt"
printf '%s\n' L04_USE_CASE="$UseCase"
printf '%s\n' L04_CODE_SHA="$CodeSha"
printf '%s\n' L04_STATUS="$status"
printf '%s\n' L04_BUNDLE_B64_BEGIN
base64 -w0 "$workdir/l04-capture.tgz"
printf '%s\n' L04_BUNDLE_B64_END
exit "$status"
'@
$RemoteScript | ssh.exe $RemoteTarget 'bash -s --' $UseCase $CodeSha $RepoUrl 2>&1 | Tee-Object -FilePath $RawCapture

Parse and persist raw bytes first; then extract L04_BUNDLE_B64 markers, verify the embedded use-case/status/code SHA and artifact hashes, retain a sanitized capture audit, and only then report this individual use-case status.
remote_cuda_workflow.capture_rule: Exactly one parameterized UseCase is run per SSH invocation; no loop. Each invocation writes a partial artifact or failure for that use case, captures stdout and stderr with 2>&1 | Tee-Object, saves LASTEXITCODE immediately, hashes raw bytes before parsing, and requires owner review before the next use case.
remote_cuda_workflow.exact_sha_rule: The remote checkout is created with mktemp under /tmp/latent-anything-l04.*, detached at $CodeSha, and verified by git rev-parse before execution; a different SHA is invalid evidence.
remote_cuda_workflow.cleanup_rule: The remote trap removes only the remotely generated mktemp workdir after capture, including repo, HF cache, uv cache, and temporary outputs; no initial client-computed rm -rf and no persistent checkout access are allowed.
